title: Settings
subtitle: Personalize this installation and prepare fiscal data and equipment.
logoHelp: Use readable images on both backgrounds. PNG, JPEG or WebP; up to 8 MB. Prefer transparent logos.
backgroundHelp: Choose a calm image without text or distracting details behind controls.
photoWarning: With a background image, light and dark themes are disabled. Custom mode uses dark surfaces to keep text readable.
colorHelp: The color may be adjusted for contrast. Button text receives a readable color.
error: Could not save. Check the fields and image.
localOnly: Preferences belong to the company, store, user and device. Saved only on this computer.
fiscalHint: These data are local preparation. Fiscal issuance requires connection and validation; confirm tax settings with your accountant.
equipmentHint: Printing preferences are prepared. Detection, connection and tests require desktop integration.
filesHint: Images are resized to keep the app lightweight. No image is sent to a server.
readOnly: Your profile can personalize appearance. Fiscal data and equipment are restricted to the authorized administrator.
